parts.tooltip: fmap f :: STM a ⟶ STM (STM b)\nAn action that runs ma and returns f a — the next action — without running it.

join :: STM (STM b) ⟶ STM b — the STM-specific part\nRuns the outer action, then the inner action, within ONE transaction.\nIf any readTVar conflicts → the entire composed transaction retries from scratch.

ports.tooltip: STM a — an atomic action on TVars (transactional variables). Not yet committed.
f : a ⟶ STM b — user code; given result a of the first action, constructs the next atomic step
STM b — the composed atomic action. Runs inside atomically :: STM a -> IO a. Never STM (STM b).
